governanceBudgetRevision.reason: Renderer governance checks source roles, paths, bundles, direct references, and function limits. GPU crowd motion adds tests and a benchmark. The Blackglass water composite adds one registered test reference. The line limit equals the measured registry. The shadow array tests now use the source-set reader, which removes one direct source reference. Frame completion timing adds five renderer ABI entries. HDR post processing adds a presentation pass and one format selection; limits increase only by the measured source growth. Opt-in sky adds shader and resource factories; limits use measured source growth. Scene node focus proxies add 7 lines to mount.ts (creating the proxy state, disposing it, and four per-frame sync calls); the proxy code lives in mount-scene-focus.ts and the limit increases only by that measured growth. The open-ocean passes add two governed renderer sources (224 WebGL2 and 211 WebGPU lines); set limits grow by exactly those lines and each file is capped at its measured size. The WebGL createScenePBRRenderer/render and WebGPU createSceneWebGPURenderer/render functions each grow by the one ocean draw call and its early-exit and dispose terms; their exceptions record the measured values. Opt-in mip bloom registers a governed pass module with limits equal to its measured source growth. WebGPU mip bloom adds the same governed filter chain and measured resource cleanup growth. The opt-in mip-chain bloom adds one dispatch per backend; exceptions record the measured values. RenderBeforeModels moves the initial render ahead of model hydration in mount.ts; its limit rises from 3866 to the measured 3884 lines. The ocean passes and the mip-chain bloom both hook into the renderers; this branch carries both, so the combined hooks raise the measured limits. Carrying both the ocean passes and the mip-chain bloom raises the WebGL and WebGPU source sets and renderer-set bytes by the sum of their measured growth. Walking registers a separate governed module; the mount line caps increase only for its lazy load and reset hooks. Shared URL loading reduces mount-webgl.ts; its cap is tightened to the measured source. Integration of the vessel controller with atmosphere, detail and walk. Clipper repairs add one physics line and two cloth lines; file caps match measured sources. rendererSourceNamingContract: Extracted backend runtime sources must live under client/runtime/scene3d and be named webgl*.ts or webgpu*.ts.
WebGPU bootstrap supplemental renderer sources must be named bootstrap-src/16aN-scene-webgpu-*.ts.
The lazy backend chunks may not add runtime Scene3D sources outside sourceSets without updating this contract and its ratchets.
